name: DeepPCB: A Printed Circuit Board Defect Detection Dataset
description: Printed circuit board defect detection dataset comprising 1,500 aligned image pairs (3,000 images total, each pair consisting of a defect-free template image and an aligned tested image at 640x640 resolution) obtained via industrial linear-scan CCD cameras at 48 pixels/mm. Features bounding-box annotations across six common PCB defect types: open circuit, short, mousebite, spur, pinhole, and spurious copper.
